CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(sHalo));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(sComp));\n\n            // 5) dIn is no longer read: IPC neighbours may push into it next iteration.\n printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", durationMs);\n\n        // Calculate performance metrics\n        double cellUpdates = (double)((nx - 2) * (ny - 2) * (nz - 2)) * iterations;\n        double mcups = cellUpdates / (durationMs / 1000.0) / 1e6;  // Million cell updates per second\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\\n\", mcups);\n    }\n\n    // ---- Gather final grid on rank displs.resize(size);\n            for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n                const Decomp d = decompose(nInterior, size, r);\n                counts[r] = (int)d.count;\n                displs[r] = (d.count > 0) ? (int)d.start : 0;\n            }\n            // Global boundary planes never change: regenerate them directly.\n            if (nz >= 1) initializeSlab(finalGrid.data(), nx, ny, 0, 1);\n                planeType, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Type_free(&planeType));\n    }\n\n    int exitCode = 0;\n    if (root) {\n        if (printResults) {\n            print_results(finalGrid, \"Grid\");\n        }\n\n        // Validation\n        if (validate) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n            bool valid = validateResult(finalGrid, nx, ny, nz);\n\n            if (valid) {\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            } else {\n                printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n                exitCode = 1;\n All of this is enqueued before the big interior\n            //    kernel so the block scheduler does not starve it.\n            launchStencil(dIn, dOut, (int)nx, (int)ny, lzFirst, lzFirst + 1, sHalo);\n            if (nloc > 1) launchStencil(dIn, dOut, (int)nx, (int)ny, lzLast, lzLast + 1, sHalo);\n            for (Neighbor& nb : nbrs) {\n                if (!nb.valid() || nb.ipc) continue;\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(nb.hSend, dOut + (size_t)nb.sendPlane * planeSize, planeBytes,\n                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, sHalo));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(nb.evCopied, sHalo));\n            }\n'''\nassert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new)\nold='''    cudaStream_t sComp, sHalo;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&sComp, cudaStreamNonBlocking));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&sHalo, cudaStreamNonBlocking));\n'''\nnew='''    // Halo stream gets the highest priority so boundary work is scheduled\n    // ahead of the (long-running) interior kernel.\n    cudaStream_t sComp, sHalo;\n    int prioLeast = 0, prioGreatest = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceGetStreamPriorityRange(&prioLeast, &prioGreatest));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithPriority(&sComp, cudaStreamNonBlocking, prioLeast));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithPriority(&sHalo, cudaStreamNonBlocking, prioGreatest));\n'''\nassert old in s; echo rc=$?; diff <(grep -vE \"time|Performance|Parallelization|Halo|^Rank\" o.txt) <(grep -vE \"time|Performance\" /tmp/ref/out_odd.txt) && echo IDENTICAL\necho \"== IPC np=2 same device\"; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 mpirun -np 2 ./stencil3d -x 128 -i 10 -v -r > o.txt 2>&1; echo rc=$?; diff <(grep -vE \"time|Performance|Parallelization|Halo|^Rank\" o.txt) <(grep -vE \"time|Performance\" /tmp/ref/out128.txt) && echo IDENTICAL\nfor np in 1 2 4; do echo \"== perf np=$np 512^3 x50\"; Only `stencil3d.cpp` and `CMakeLists.txt` were changed, the executable is still `stencil3d`, and every output is bit-identical to the original serial code.\n\n**How the parallelization works**\n\n- **MPI** splits the interior z-planes into contiguous slabs, one per rank, each padded with one halo plane on either side. Ranks that end up with no planes (more ranks than planes) are skipped transparently.\n- **CUDA** runs the stencil on one GPU per rank (node-local rank modulo GPU count). The kernel uses one thread per (x,y) column with a register sliding window along z. Boundary planes are computed first on a high-priority stream so the halo exchange overlaps the interior kernel on a second stream.\n- **Halo exchange** is GPU-direct via CUDA IPC when neighbors share a node and peer access is supported, with MPI carrying only zero-byte synchronization tokens. Otherwise it falls back to nonblocking MPI through pinned host staging buffers. The mode is negotiated per link and printed at startup.\n- **OpenMP** parallelizes host-side work: slab initialization, boundary regeneration, and validation reductions.\n- Boundary cells are never written by the kernel and both device buffers hold the initial values, which is equivalent to the original's per-iteration boundary copy. Timing covers only the iteration loop, reduced as the max over ranks.\n\n**Verification** against the original binary (sum, min, max, samples, and hash identical in all cases):\n\n| Configuration | Result |\n|---|---|\n| 1, 2, 3, 4, 8 ranks at 128³ | identical |\n| 4 ranks at 100×70×37 and 256³ | identical |\n| IPC path (ranks on one GPU), mixed IPC + staged | identical |\n| More ranks than planes, nx=2, zero iterations | identical |\n\n**Performance** on this node (4× RTX 3090):\n\n| Run | Time | Throughput |\n|---|---|---|\n| Original serial, 512³ | 338 ms/iter | 0.39 GCells/s |\n| 1 GPU, 512³ | 6.6 ms/iter | 20.0 GCells/s |\n| 4 GPUs, 512³ | 2.1 ms/iter | 64.4 GCells/s |\n| 4 GPUs, 1024³ | 13.5 ms/iter | 79.1 GCells/s |\n\n**One caveat.** These GeForce cards do not support peer access, so cross-GPU IPC is rejected by the driver and the run falls back to the host-staged MPI path, with a notice on stderr. On data-center GPUs with NVLink or PCIe peer access, the GPU-direct path engages automatically. The host-staged path was the one profiled and tuned here, so the numbers above reflect it.\n\nBuild as before with CMake. It requires CUDA, MPI, and an OpenMP-capable host compiler, and targets the native GPU architecture by default (override with `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES`)."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":32,"cache_creation_input_tokens":587,"cache_read_input_tokens":111481,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":587},"output_tokens":792,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ad601276-685b-48de-9ce8-77b5ac612b35","uuid":"a9bbb39e-06c6-4770-a1f5-9e122eb923f6","timestamp":"2026-10-16T13:21:52.450Z","request_id":"req_011Cg5z9MgBVPJ39xskbrQSV"}
